title: 第17章 打通天脉始祖源界罪血后代第18章 雪花勇闯天涯揍我七叔众享丝滑
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
又是三年过去，叶天澜已经来到了六岁，彻底成长为了一名丰神俊朗，面如冠玉，玉树临风的翩翩少年。
在萧家的这五年时间里，他每日大补的妖兽肉从未断过，修炼资源更是最优先调动给他。
一切皆以最高规格的来分配，甚至比一众萧家核心子弟还要多得多。
也因此，他身形外貌格外出众，如果不看脸的话，单看身材还无法辨认出他的准确年龄。
偶尔还有各位族老爷爷给他带来一些在外界能够引发腥风血雨争斗的好东西。
在如此不遗余力的倾注之下，他的实力进展飞快，目前整个萧家之中除了李秀清和洛珺仙之外，根本没有人知道他的实力已经到达了何种地步。
此时在两人所居住的内院之中，房间里面。
叶天澜正小脸肃穆，身着玉白色云纹锦衣，腰系价值数千灵石的寒月宝玉，盘膝端坐在床榻之上。
若有人仔细的观察的话便是可以发现，这床榻竟是由一整块完整的地心炎髓所制造而成的。
对于常人来说仅仅佩戴一小块就可以凝练天地元气，促进元气冲刷经脉速度的珍贵宝物地心炎髓，而叶天澜这里却有足足一整床，日夜都直接睡在上面！
这已经不能用简单的豪气奢华来形容。
整个偌大的萧族之内，除了他之外根本没有第二人有这种待遇，即便是洛珺仙也没有。
此时此刻，在他周身，元力气息犹如喷涌的潮水般汩汩滚荡着。
房间中云雾飘渺，犹如薄雾一般流淌滚动不断。
然而这些都不是普通的水蒸气，而是实实在在在的被疯狂吸引过来的天地元气！
隐隐约约之间，这些浩大的天地元气都在以一种顺时针的速度缓缓旋转着。
在他周身更是有着足足八十四道气旋盘旋左右，声势磅礴的场景犹如将他整个人给包裹在了风暴中心。
仔细看去便能发现，即便是这八十四道气旋也是有区别的。
其中十二条呈现出雾化的虚态状，另外七十二条则是颜色略微的晦暗，但相较于前者而言却是要更加凝实许多。
而此时，在这八十四道元气气旋的正中间，重重风暴中心之内正有一道呈现为乳白色的气旋在缓缓的酝酿而成。

仅仅只是这一道未成形的气旋，其威势就已经堪比之前七十二地脉加上十二主脉所闹出的动静！
“这便是先天之脉吗，只蕴藏于人体最深处，在七十二地脉之后···”洛珺仙喃喃，婀娜窈窕的身段倚在床边，默默为叶天澜护法。
“啧啧，这才仅仅只是第一条天脉呢，这小子果然是绝世妖才，年仅六岁就已经开辟打通了第一条天脉。”
洛珺仙忽地意上心头，在脑海中问道：“剑爷，以您的阅历来看，以往所听闻的最为传说强大的天才是在什么时候开辟天脉的。”
残缺的玉石小剑散发出一阵明灭不定的光芒。
似乎是在回忆，许久方才响起幽幽之声。
“那便要当属那人了，八岁开辟第一条天脉，十五岁即是周身经脉圆满，冲刺三年，不得帝脉之径，最终于十八岁那年凝聚明月生海潮异象，一朝踏入聚气之境，从此踏上无敌之路，同辈同境再无敌手，横推强敌邪祟，一路登临至高帝位。”
洛珺仙瞳孔一阵颤动，美眸中难以掩饰震撼之意，单单只是听闻她仿佛都能够感受到一道无敌的英姿背影映入脑海之中。、
那般盖世气魄，古来几人可有？
content_en:
Another three years have passed, and Ye Tianlan has reached the age of six, and has completely grown into a handsome young man with a face as beautiful as a crown jade and a tree as tall as the wind.
During the five years in the Xiao family, he had never stopped consuming monster meat every day, and training resources were given top priority to him.
Everything is distributed according to the highest standards, even much more than the core children of the Xiao family.
Because of this, his figure and appearance are particularly outstanding. If you don't look at his face, you can't tell his exact age just by looking at his figure.
Occasionally, clan elders would bring him some good things that could trigger bloody battles in the outside world.
With such unremitting efforts, his strength has developed rapidly. Currently, except for Li Xiuqing and Luo Junxian, no one in the entire Xiao family knows how far his strength has reached.
At this time, they were in the inner courtyard and room where the two of them lived.
Ye Tianlan has a solemn face, wearing a jade-white cloud-patterned brocade dress, with a Hanyue jade worth thousands of spiritual stones tied around his waist, sitting cross-legged on the bed.
If someone observes carefully, they can find that this bed is actually made from a complete piece of earth core inflammation marrow.
For ordinary people, just wearing a small piece of the precious treasure Earth Heart Flame Essence can condense the vitality of heaven and earth and promote the speed of vitality flushing through the meridians. However, Ye Tianlan has a full bed here and sleeps on it day and night!
This can no longer be described as simple luxury and luxury.
In the entire Xiao clan, apart from him, no one else had such treatment, not even Luo Junxian.
At this moment, around him, the aura of Yuanli surged like a gushing tide.
The mist in the room was misty, flowing and rolling like mist.
However, these are not ordinary water vapor, but the real vitality of heaven and earth that is attracted by madness!
Vaguely, these vast energies of heaven and earth were slowly rotating at a clockwise speed.
There were eighty-four cyclones circling around him, and the majestic scene seemed to wrap him up in the center of the storm.
If you look carefully, you will find that even these eighty-four cyclones are different.
Twelve of them are in an atomized virtual state, and the other seventy-two are slightly darker in color, but they are much more solid than the former.
At this time, in the middle of these eighty-four vitality cyclones, there was a milky white cyclone slowly brewing in the center of the storm.
Just this unformed cyclone, its power is already comparable to the previous commotion caused by the seventy-two earth veins plus the twelve main veins!
"Is this the innate vein? It is only contained in the deepest part of the human body, after the seventy-two earth veins..." Luo Junxian murmured, leaning on the bedside with her graceful figure, silently protecting Ye Tianlan.
"Tsk, tsk, this is just the first heavenly vein. This boy is indeed a peerless talent. He has already opened up the first heavenly vein at the age of six."
Luo Junxian suddenly thought about it and asked in his mind: "Master Jian, judging from your experience, when did the most legendary and powerful genius that I have heard of in the past open up the heavenly veins."
The incomplete jade sword emitted a burst of light that flickered on and off.
It seemed that he was reminiscing, and a faint voice sounded after a long time.
"Then it must be that person. The first heavenly veins were opened at the age of eight. The meridians all over the body were perfected at the age of fifteen. After three years of sprinting, he could not find the path to the emperor's veins. Finally, at the age of eighteen, he condensed the bright moon and created the vision of the sea tide. Once he stepped into the realm of gathering Qi, he embarked on the road of invincibility. There is no rival in the same generation and in the same realm. He pushed forward the powerful enemies of evil spirits and ascended to the throne of the high emperor."
Luo Junxian's pupils trembled, and her beautiful eyes could not conceal the shock. Just hearing that she seemed to be able to feel an invincible heroic figure reflected in her mind. ,
Such unparalleled aura, ancientHow many people are coming?
